description: Shares that failed to settle, from the SEC's fails-to-deliver data (NSCC): a stock's outstanding fail balance on each settlement date over the latest half-month files, with prices and dollar values, or the securities with the largest fails across the market.

files.description: Half-month files to read, newest first; default 2 (about a month) for a ticker, 1 across the market.

limit.description: Across the market, most securities to list; default 25.

symbol.description: A ticker. Without it, the securities with the largest fails by value in the latest file.

name: fails_to_deliver

outputSchema.description: rows are settlement dates with the outstanding fail balance (one stock) or securities ranked by their largest balance by value (the market).

title: Fails to deliver (SEC)
